title: Claim your conference travel grant today
scenario: An email says you've been awarded a travel grant for a conference, but funds release today only, and you must confirm your bank details through a linked form before the deadline passes.

answers.A: Contact your department directly to confirm the grant is real before entering any bank details.
answers.B: Fill in the form, and also share it with a labmate who might want a grant.
answers.C: Fill in the form quickly to receive the funds today.

explanation: Genuine grant administration doesn't collect bank details through a same-day emailed form - a real award goes through your university's finance office.
proTip: A grant you didn't apply urgency to shouldn't come with urgency attached to it.
